tldr: Venus in the 11th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward friends, community, and goals
body: Venus in the 11th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward friends, community, and goals. Gift: ease and charm there. Watch: indulgence or avoidance. With Venus in the 11th house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through friendship, community, networks, hopes, audiences, and the future. This makes how you belong, collaborate, and give your gifts to something larger than yourself a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through community and future vision.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in community and future vision.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
